en: The Discourse on Full Understanding of All.
This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant; thus have I heard:
“Bhikkhus, without directly knowing all, without fully understanding all, without dispassion toward it and without abandoning it, one is incapable of the destruction of suffering.”
“Monks, by fully knowing and fully understanding everything, and by detaching the mind from it and abandoning it, one is capable of the destruction of suffering.
Thus the Blessed One spoke. Regarding this, it is said:
“He who, having known everything from every perspective,
is not attached to anything at all—
he indeed possesses the full understanding of everything.”
This meaning was also spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
